paragraphs: An unbiased NFL prediction model (win probability, point spread, total) built on situation-neutral efficiency metrics, compared against sportsbook closing lines and live Kalshi prices, with a website that updates itself.
features: Efficiency: EPA per pass and per rush, success rate, early-down (1st and 2nd) EPA, explosive play rate (EPA above 1.5), offense and defense

Passing: CPOE, average depth of target, yards after catch per target, pressure rate and EPA under pressure vs clean pocket (pressure = sack or QB hit, the best signal available in nflfastR), starting QB EPA per dropback…

Transformations: 7-game exponential moving average weighted by neutral plays, regressed halfway to league average each offseason. Weekly ridge regression of EPA on offense and defense identity for opponent-adjusted…
Context: rest difference, travel miles, time-zone shift and eastward travel, wind above 15 mph, temperature below 25°F, division and playoff games

Home field: models are trained on each game in both directions (home and away swapped), so they learn neutral-site strength. Home field is then added as a single term chosen from 1.2 to 1.8 points by out-of-sample log…
